instruction: Download and install the Arc theme from gnome-look.org, then apply it as the GTK theme for my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Variation 8: Similar to original task but installs Arc theme instead of Orchis. Uses same evaluator pattern - checks gtk-theme setting via gsettings for 'Arc' string. No custom functions needed as check_list metric is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings to verify GTK theme setting, which is the appropriate method for checking GNOME theme application
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the critical requirement (theme is applied) while the installation is implicitly verified by successful application
Correct comparison logic: check_list with regex pattern 'Arc' appropriately matches the theme name in gsettings output
Pattern 'Arc' is appropriately permissive to match valid Arc theme variants (Arc, Arc-Dark, Arc-Darker)
Data flow is correct: postconfig executes gsettings command -> saves to cache file -> getter reads file -> metric searches for pattern
Practical feasibility confirmed: gsettings command will output theme name in format 'ThemeName', which check_list can successfully search
